author: Arnav
problem: flights is a list of (flight code, (hour, minute)) scheduled departures and curfew is an (hour, minute) time. Return the codes of the flights that depart before the curfew, in list order.
bug_description: Compares only the hours (dep[0] < curfew[0]) instead of the whole time, so a flight leaving in the curfew's hour but before its minute is dropped.

comments.accurate: Keeps the flights whose departure time is earlier than the curfew
comments.wrong_behavior: Keeps the flights that leave before the curfew hour begins
comments.wrong_location: Departure check verified; check each flight's code and time are unpacked in the right order
